summary: Comprehensive testing of Moto Import platform - Images from MongoDB, Parts Shop, Service Worker v3, and Mobile Header. All major features working correctly.

minor.issue: Brief error toast appears on admin parts page - likely race condition with push notifications API

passed_tests: Backend: /api/images/{id} returns image data from MongoDB (200 status, correct content-type)
Backend: Non-existent image returns 404 with Dutch error message
Backend: Motorcycles have image URLs pointing to /api/images/{id}
Backend: /api/parts/categories returns categories list
Backend: /api/parts/brands returns motorcycle brands
Backend: /api/parts returns parts with filters (category, brand, search)
Backend: /api/parts/all requires admin authentication
Backend: /api/parts/order requires authentication
Backend: /api/parts/orders/my returns dealer's orders
Backend: Admin login returns token
Backend: Dealer login returns token with is_approved field
Frontend: Login page loads correctly
Frontend: Dealer dashboard shows motorcycles with images from MongoDB
Frontend: Motorcycle detail page displays image from /api/images/{id}
Frontend: Parts shop loads with categories, brands, search filters
Frontend: Add to cart functionality works
Frontend: Cart shows items with quantity controls
Frontend: Checkout dialog shows shipping options (€9.95 or free pickup)
Frontend: Admin parts management page loads
Frontend: Add part dialog has all form fields (name, price, stock, category, brands)
Frontend: Add category button present
Frontend: Mobile header shows Moto Import logo, refresh button, language selector
Frontend: Language switching works (NL/DE/FR/IT)
Frontend: German translation shows 'Anmelden', 'Passwort', 'Händler Anleitung'
Service Worker: v3 with Network First strategy accessible
Service Worker: manifest.json properly configured for PWA
critical_code_review_comments: Images are correctly stored in MongoDB as base64 and served via /api/images/{id}
Service Worker v3 uses Network First strategy for iOS PWA caching fix
Parts shop has proper cart functionality with shipping options
Mobile header correctly shows refresh button and language selector
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test accounts and data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working: 1) Images stored in MongoDB and served via /api/images/{id}, 2) Service Worker v3 with Network First strategy, 3) Parts shop with cart, checkout, shipping options, 4) Admin parts management with CRUD, 5) Mobile header with refresh button and language selector. Parts don't have images yet (empty arrays) but the upload functionality exists.

images_from_mongodb.details: Images stored as base64 in MongoDB, served via /api/images/{id} with proper content-type and caching headers

motorcycle_images_in_catalog.details: Motorcycle cards and detail pages display images from MongoDB URLs

service_worker_v3.details: Network First strategy implemented, auto-update with skipWaiting, iOS PWA fix in place

parts_shop_categories.details: 4 categories available: Uitlaten, Tanktassen, Koffers, Luxe Zadels

parts_shop_cart.details: Add to cart, quantity controls, remove items all functional

parts_shop_checkout.details: Shipping (€9.95) or free pickup options, order summary, confirm button

admin_parts_management.details: Add/edit/delete parts, add categories, brand compatibility selection

mobile_header_refresh.details: Refresh button visible in mobile header with RefreshCw icon

language_selector_mobile.details: Language selector visible in mobile header, switches between NL/DE/FR/IT

login_flow.details: Admin and dealer login both functional with proper redirects
